patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; WhatConverts is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose LearnWorlds only if your buying job matches “AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than LearnWorlds's shape. Workflow advantage: LearnWorlds leans creator-marketing, funnel-building; WhatConverts leans analytics. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; WhatConverts is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: LearnWorlds is AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Workflow coverage skew: LearnWorlds-leaning creator-marketing, funnel-building, multichannel-campaigns vs WhatConverts-leaning analytics.
- Researched limits: LearnWorlds — Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — LearnWorlds: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Active learner and admin caps by plan; WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.

Poor-fit cases: LearnWorlds is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment · WhatConverts is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite · Avoid LearnWorlds if you actually need WhatConverts's motion (Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
